QuickPal Bitwarden CLI fork 2026.8.0

QuickPal distributes a source-built Windows x64 Bitwarden CLI executable as a
separate program and communicates with it through the command-line and local
Vault Management API interfaces. The fork adds authenticated local transport
for QuickPal; it does not change Bitwarden vault cryptography.

Fork source:
https://github.com/TheItalianGame/quickpal-bitwarden

Pinned commit:
2e4b1fba6e02ca9822043ba89deb8809468e0b7b

Upstream source/tag:
https://github.com/bitwarden/clients/tree/cli-v2026.8.0

The generated executable's SHA-256 and exact build toolchain are recorded in
PROVENANCE.json beside this notice. The forked executable is not signed by
Bitwarden Inc. The accompanying LICENSE.txt, LICENSE_GPL.txt, and
LICENSE_BITWARDEN.txt files are copied from the pinned source tree.

Bitwarden is a trademark of Bitwarden Inc. QuickPal is not affiliated with or
endorsed by Bitwarden Inc.
